For nearly 30 years, Henriquez has protested his innocence claiming the police set him up.

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Episode 4 In Piers Morgan's previous interviews with convicted serial killers, all protested their innocence. Over three months in late 1973, 20-year-old Bernard Giles picked up five innocent young women hitchhiking through his neighbourhood, and slaughtered each of them in cold blood. Fortunate to be spared the death penalty, he will never be released from prison.
programme.title: Confessions of a Serial Killer with Piers Morgan
